title: Where the browser runs
description: A page served by a Worker at cyberspace-explorer.com that runs in the reader's browser and reads public repositories straight from their hosts; for a reader signed in with GitHub, it reads GitHub through the Worker, which holds their token.

nodes.name: Reader's browser
nodes.description: Any current browser, on a laptop or a desktop monitor.

nodes.name: Cyberspace explorer
nodes.description: The page and its script, running in the browser tab.

nodes.name: Browser storage
nodes.description: sessionStorage and localStorage, holding the reader's tokens under cyberspace-explorer.tokens.

nodes.name: cyberspace-explorer.com
nodes.description: Cloudflare's network, answering for cyberspace-explorer.com as a Workers custom domain.

nodes.name: cyberspace-explorer Worker
nodes.description: Serves the page, and the GitHub sign-in and the read-only door to GitHub's API when its secrets are set.

nodes.name: Sealed cookies
nodes.description: explorer_oauth during a sign-in and explorer_session after it, kept by the browser, HttpOnly, sealed by the Worker; the page cannot read them.
nodes.condition: the reader signs in with GitHub

nodes.name: jsDelivr
nodes.description: Serves dagre and the Barlow typefaces.

nodes.name: GitHub API
nodes.description: api.github.com: the default branch, the recursive tree, and files when a token is in use; for a signed-in reader, called by the Worker instead of the page.

nodes.name: raw.githubusercontent.com
nodes.description: Files of a GitHub repository read without a token.
nodes.condition: the address is on github.com and no token covers it

nodes.name: GitLab API
nodes.description: /api/v4 on gitlab.com or a self-hosted GitLab that allows the page's origin.
nodes.condition: the address is not on github.com

nodes.name: GitHub OAuth
nodes.description: github.com/login/oauth: where the reader authorizes the app, and where the Worker exchanges the code for a token.
nodes.condition: the Worker's secrets are set and the reader signs in

artifacts.name: index.html
artifacts.description: The whole page: markup, styles, script and icons. Bundled into the Worker as text and served at /.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: worker/index.js and worker/app.js, deployed by wrangler with wrangler.jsonc.

relationships.description: Keeps the storage for the page's origin.
Loads the typefaces and the layout library.
Lists the repository; with a pasted token, reads files too. Not used for a reader signed in through the Worker.
Reads each .dev file when no token covers the repository and the reader is not signed in.
Lists the project and reads each .dev file.
Reads and writes the reader's tokens.
Runs the Worker for every request to cyberspace-explorer.com.
Keeps the Worker's cookies for cyberspace-explorer.com.
Asks /auth/me on load; signed in, lists and reads GitHub through /api/github over HTTPS.
Sets and reads them on its responses and requests.
Redirects the reader there, and exchanges the code over HTTPS.
Looks up the signed-in account and forwards the page's reads, with the reader's token.
